ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: At the bottom of the figure is a common wire and it is grounded; above there are two nodes labeled a and b. Between a and b is connected resistor R5, labeled as 1 Ω, and the arrow of current I5 points from a to b. From node a to ground there is a branch R2=1 Ω; on the left side there is also R1=1 Ω in series with a 12 V voltage source, the upper end of the voltage source is positive, and it is connected to node a. From node b to ground there is an unknown resistor R3; on the right side there is a 16 A current source with its arrow upward connected into node b; the far-right branch is R4=1 Ω connected to ground. Reasoning: Let the bottom wire be the reference ground, and the node voltages be Va and Vb. Because in the R5 branch I5=0, there is no voltage drop across R5, so Va=Vb. Write KCL at node a: the current through R2 to ground plus the current through R1 flowing to the fixed 12 V node has sum 0, namely Va/1+(Va-12)/1=0, solving gives 2Va-12=0, so Va=6 V. Therefore Vb=6 V. At node b, R5 has no current, and the current injected by the 16 A current source flows out through R4 and R3, so 6/1+6/R3=16. Thus 6/R3=10, R3=0.6 Ω. To one decimal place it is 0.6 Ω.

method.method_draft: First describe the circuit and assign ground to the bottom conductor. Let node voltages be Va and Vb. Because I5=0 in R5, set Va=Vb. Apply KCL at node b: the 16 A source current must leave through R4 and R3 because no current flows through R5, so 6/1+6/R3=16. Solve for R3 and round to one decimal place.

method.method_draft: First inspect the image to split the circuit at R5 between terminals a and b. Since I5=0, remove R5 for calculation and require the open-circuit voltages Va_oc and Vb_oc to be the same. On the left, node a is connected by equal 1 Ω resistors to 12 V and to ground, so Va_oc=12×1/(1+1)=6 V. On the right, the 16 A current source drives the parallel combination of R4=1 Ω and R3, so Vb_oc=16·(R3||1). Set Vb_oc=6 V, i.e. 16·R3/(R3+1)=6, solve for R3, and round to one decimal place.
